question: What division does the speaker seek to know fully and endlessly?
premises: A division is the object of inquiry
The division consists of eight groups of eight
The speaker seeks to know it fully and endlessly
inference: The speaker seeks complete and endless knowledge of the division into eight groups of eight
uncertainties: The exact sense of anantathā as endlessly or in infinite detail is interpretive
plain_english: I seek to know fully and endlessly the division into eight groups of eight.
